findings.title: update command blocks on stdin without non-interactive bypass
findings.suggested_fix: Add TTY detection. If stdin is not a TTY and --content is empty, raise actionable error instead of blocking. Example: check sys.stdin.isatty() and require --content when not a TTY.

findings.title: judge command returns exit code 0 even when verification tiers fail
findings.suggested_fix: After printing tier results, check if any result.passed is False. If any tier failed, raise typer.Exit(code=1).

findings.title: No --json/structured output option for judge/close/done commands
findings.suggested_fix: Add --format option (e.g., --format=console|json) to judge, close, done. When --format=json, serialize HarnessResult as JSON to stdout.

residual_risks: close/done have no --dry-run flag. Agent cannot preview what would fail before committing to close. By design (MVP no-bypass) but limits inspectability.
update silently succeeds with 'No content provided, nothing written' when stdin empty. Agent sending empty content gets no error and no state change.
testing_gaps: No integration test for update with piped stdin (non-TTY)
No test verifying judge exit code when tiers fail
No test for structured output on data-returning commands
